verdict.rationale: Mercury Books ships several always-on automations (continuous reconciliation/categorization, recurring invoices, multi-layer bill approval rules, duplicate-bill detection) that run in the background without user intervention, but true AI-agent-driven end-to-end automation (the accounting API and MCP layer for agents) is explicitly described as 'soon,' not yet available, and Mercury's own blog cautions that connected bookkeeping is 'not the same as fully automated' and should not be treated as 'autopilot.' All evidence is vendor-provided claimed-docs (plus failed probes for an API/llms.txt), so there's no independent corroboration either way. missing for 10: shipped MCP/agent API enabling autonomous end-to-end bookkeeping automations, independent/hands-on confirmation that existing automations run reliably unattended, and clarity on what 'autonomous' automation setup actually looks like today versus roadmap promises.
